title: PsyCoMark: Psycholinguistic Conspiracy Marker Extraction and Detection
description: SemEval-2026 Task 10 (PsyCoMark): studying how conspiracy theories are expressed in social-media (Reddit) statements. Annotators make a document-level conspiracy judgment (Yes / No / Can't tell) and extract five psycholinguistic conspiracy markers as spans: Actor, Action, Effect, Victim, and Evidence.
